From 374e66d8d1380e87d9ff0e4f3a7ea79945e54c3a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Agili <git@agili.app>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 00:06:27 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] feat(registry): add Tungshing dashboard
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Add the 黄历 (Tungshing) dashboard from baranwang/metrix-bar at commit
0ef89e9 with the pinned SHA-256 of the published .bar bytes. Upstream
declares no license for it, so it is recorded as UNLICENSED.

Closes #160
---
 AGENTS.md             |  2 +-
 README.md             |  1 +
 README.zh-CN.md       |  1 +
 registry/sources.json | 14 ++++++++++++++
 4 files changed, 17 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/AGENTS.md b/AGENTS.md
index a77b90c..6503bf0 100644
--- a/AGENTS.md
+++ b/AGENTS.md
@@ -29,7 +29,7 @@
 
 ## Dashboard sources
 
-- [baranwang/metrix-bar](https://github.com/baranwang/metrix-bar): the root `index.json` contains Komari and Tokens. Include each dashboard only once.
+- [baranwang/metrix-bar](https://github.com/baranwang/metrix-bar): the root `index.json` contains Komari, Tokens and Tungshing. Include each dashboard only once. Komari and Tokens declare AGPL-3.0-only inside the `.bar`; Tungshing declares no license, so it is recorded as `UNLICENSED`.
 - [Pulse](https://github.com/fatwang2/Pulse/blob/main/metrix/README.md): resolve `metrix/index.json` and `metrix/pulse.bar` from the `metrix/` directory, not the repository root.
 - [Codex Resets](https://github.com/0tt0/codex-resets-bar): include both `codex-resets.bar` and `codex-resets-en.bar` using their actual metadata.
 - [JasonChou0v0/metrix-bar-dashboards](https://github.com/JasonChou0v0/metrix-bar-dashboards): files are under `dashboards/`. No upstream license is declared; record `UNLICENSED`. Local Ports requires the upstream macOS collector described in its README; do not execute it during registry generation.
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index a1aa1d7..d787f46 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ Then open a dashboard's page, follow its setup notes, and choose **Install**. Yo
 | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
 | [`komari`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/komari)                   | Server monitoring                 |
 | [`tokens`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/tokens)                   | AI coding usage                   |
+| [`tungshing`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/tungshing)             | Chinese lunar almanac             |
 | [`pulse`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/pulse)                     | Stocks and cryptocurrency         |
 | [`codex-resets`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/codex-resets)       | Codex quota resets (Chinese)      |
 | [`codex-resets-en`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/codex-resets-en) | Codex quota resets (English)      |
diff --git a/README.zh-CN.md b/README.zh-CN.md
index b699e2e..c64b82b 100644
--- a/README.zh-CN.md
+++ b/README.zh-CN.md
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/index.json
 | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
 | [`komari`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/komari)                   | 服务器监控              |
 | [`tokens`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/tokens)                   | AI 编程用量             |
+| [`tungshing`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/tungshing)             | 农历黄历                |
 | [`pulse`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/pulse)                     | 股票与加密货币          |
 | [`codex-resets`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/codex-resets)       | Codex 额度重置（中文）  |
 | [`codex-resets-en`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/codex-resets-en) | Codex 额度重置（英文）  |
diff --git a/registry/sources.json b/registry/sources.json
index f6d6877..f32334c 100644
--- a/registry/sources.json
+++ b/registry/sources.json
@@ -51,6 +51,20 @@
         }
       ]
     },
+    {
+      "id": "tungshing",
+      "repository": "baranwang/metrix-bar",
+      "path": "tungshing/tungshing.bar",
+      "author": "baranwang",
+      "license": "UNLICENSED",
+      "releases": [
+        {
+          "commit": "0ef89e96278f0f977ba091228cd52635ac889ea8",
+          "version": "1.0.0",
+          "sha256": "d143b12970c3df03b1e71f123cf64f7cc0c06879464aa0cd22d14c71840d5fd9"
+        }
+      ]
+    },
     {
       "id": "pulse",
       "repository": "fatwang2/Pulse",
